description_zh: 了了了岭工作室制作的数独游戏，提供经典数独、迷你与大型棋盘及多种变体。可挑战每日谜题、限时模式，也可查看游戏统计。
description_en: A Sudoku game by Leleleling Studio featuring classic, mini and mega boards, plus puzzle variants. Play daily challenges or time attack and review your statistics.
summary: 包含经典、迷你、大型棋盘和多种变体的数独游戏
summary_en: Sudoku with classic, mini, mega and variant puzzles
